summary: Implemented set_window_title in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title), which passes the type and title as one two-item argument; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title after show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False, with the required docstring; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added section with a PR 2200 bullet; tests added in test_console.py (skips on legacy Windows), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was executed, so the tests and mypy are unverified. Note that the method inherits control()'s is_dumb_terminal check, so on a dumb terminal it returns True without writing, the same as show_cursor.
